title: Flaky: ui/scripts git-paths-nested-layout test times out at 15s in Test UI (1/16)
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① CI flake with a named producer, seen by the domain:skills seat on PR #32556 (a `scripts/pm/**` + workflow diff that touches no `ui/**` path). ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## What failed

`Test UI (1/16)`, run 43155985148 attempt 1, job 130976690042, head `8f329f4d0`: `ui/scripts/__tests__/git-paths-nested-layout.test.ts:77` — "Test timed out in 15000ms". The same job passed on its one re-run (attempt 2, job 130982100649) with no change to the head.

## Reach

Any PR whose Test UI matrix runs that shard: a red that is not the PR's, costing a re-run and a reader's time.

## Duplicate check

Searched open issues for `git-paths-nested-layout`: none.
